title: Unit – 4 : Session – 7 : SLO – 2  |  Execute Parallel Tasks with Process Pools
sections: Pool(3) creates three worker processes; map() sends each number to a worker and collects the cubes.
The __main__ guard is required so child processes (spawned/forked) do not re-run the pool creation code.
Output: [1, 8, 27] — computed in parallel across the worker processes.
